links.outcome: AI vs manual behavioral audiometry sensitivity, specificity, AUC by age group
links.effect: Ages 2.5-4: AI sensitivity 0.929 vs manual 0.900, but manual specificity 0.824 and AUC 0.901 higher. Ages 4-6: manual sensitivity 0.943, specificity 0.947, AUC 0.924 all higher than AI.
links.quote: For children aged 4-6 years, the sensitivity (0.943), specificity (0.947), and AUC (0.924) of artificial behavioral audiometry were higher than those of AI behavioral audiometry.

screen.reason: The study develops and prospectively deploys a computer vision/deep learning system for posture recognition during pediatric behavioral audiometry and evaluates its diagnostic performance against human examiners.
